Real fact ⚡ Lightning can heat the air to about 27,000°C, around 5x the Sun's surface. But the Sun's core is about 15 million °C!

Which world do you pick? 🅰️ Hot lightning  🅱️ Calm lightning 👇
Haha, kind of true! 😅 A stored onion is a dormant living bulb (it can still sprout), and those tears are its chemical defence kicking in when the cells break.
